DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis.

Your history of weakness worsening at the end of the day combined with new-onset diplopia (double vision) is highly characteristic of myasthenia gravis, an autoimmune disorder affecting neuromuscular transmission. A urinary tract infection does not typically present with diplopia or this specific pattern of fatigable muscle weakness.
